card.name: Words inside purpose phrases
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a purpose or goal phrase, such as "effort" or "to" after "in an effort", and words after "to give", "to achieve" or "to obtain the best". It fires where a goal or aim is being stated.

modes.label: In an effort/attempt to
modes.description: The word "effort" or "attempt", or the "to" that follows, in a phrase giving an aim.
modes.example: But we continue to keep up with the current technologies in an<< effort>> to protect the security of your information.

modes.label: Goal verb then object
modes.description: A word right after a verb of aiming or achieving, such as "to give", "achieve" or "obtain the best".
modes.example: To obtain the best<< possible>> outcome, NAC should be administered as
